item.title: Facial recognition at protest sites: update
item.description:
SFLC.in v. Union of India; A.A. Rahim v. Union of India (Supreme Court)

The question: Whether police may use facial recognition on people at designated protest sites without a law authorising it.

Where it stands: Notice issued on 3 November 2026 on SFLC.in's petition, tagged with A.A. Rahim's earlier plea on the July Jantar Mantar protests. The Union is yet to reply.

Next date not yet reported
